entities.summary: Olusegun Awolowo Jr. was a Nigerian lawyer. He was the executive director of Nigerian Export Promotion Council from 2013 to 2021. He was the grandson of Nigerian nationalist, socialist and statesman, Chief Obafemi Awolowo. In July 2021, he was unanimously elected as the President of National Trade Promotion Organizations (TPOs) from ECOWAS member States.
